verdict.rationale: Capacities has some automation-adjacent features, such as scheduled automated exports and an AI assistant that proposes creates and updates for the user to approve. None of the evidence shows versioning, review history, or rollback of user-defined automations. Approving individual AI-proposed edits is not the same as versioning or rolling back an automation, and the API versioning mentioned in the docs covers the API itself rather than user automations.
